description: Given a file path and a 32-byte AES key (uint8_t*), generate 12-byte nonce via RAND_bytes, encrypt file contents using AES-256-GCM via EVP_CIPHER_CTX, write output to original_path.PROCESSED with format [12-byte nonce][ciphertext][16-byte GCM tag]. Overwrite original file with zeros, then remove using remove().
name: apply_transform
